verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports an isolated test environment. A separate free or pay-as-you-go account and free services (azure-docs-16, azure-docs-17) give a place to experiment, declarative IaC (Bicep, ARM, Terraform) can reproduce environments, and RBAC can scope access to specific resources. None of these is documented as a sandbox or non-production testing feature. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test-environment capability, documented isolation of test data from production data, guidance on environment separation for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
